intro: A 50 Hz diesel-set reference for commercial standby and prime-power discussions.
Mfano wa jenereta ya dizeli ya 50 Hz kwa mahitaji ya biashara ya umeme wa akiba au matumizi ya kawaida.
facts: Manufacturer reference: 100 kVA prime / 110 kVA standby. These are different duty ratings, not interchangeable promises.
Rejea ya mtengenezaji: 100 kVA prime / 110 kVA standby. Hivi ni viwango vya matumizi tofauti, si uwezo unaobadilishana bila tathmini.
Final configuration, site derating, enclosure, transfer equipment and installation scope are confirmed in your quotation.
Muundo wa mwisho, athari za hali ya eneo, kifuniko, vifaa vya kubadili umeme na kazi ya ufungaji vitathibitishwa kwenye nukuu.

intro: An electric-power engine reference for engine selection and correctly identified service parts.
Rejea ya injini ya kuzalisha umeme kwa uchaguzi wa injini na utambuzi sahihi wa vipuri.
facts: This is an engine, not a complete generator set. The alternator, controller, cooling and enclosure belong to the complete-set specification.
Hii ni injini, si jenereta kamili. Alternator, kidhibiti, mfumo wa kupooza na kifuniko ni sehemu za vipimo vya jenereta nzima.
For parts, send the engine serial number, build information and existing part reference; appearance alone is insufficient.
Kwa vipuri, tuma namba ya injini, taarifa za muundo na namba ya kipuri kilichopo; mwonekano pekee hautoshi.

intro: Single-set automatic mains-failure control, with engine monitoring and configurable transfer logic.
Udhibiti wa jenereta moja wakati umeme mkuu unapokatika, ufuatiliaji wa injini na mipangilio ya kubadili chanzo.
facts: The controller is not the complete ATS panel. Correct switching devices, interlocks, protection and sensing must be specified together.
Kidhibiti si paneli nzima ya ATS. Vifaa vya kubadili umeme, interlock, kinga na vipimo vya mfumo vinapaswa kuchaguliwa kwa pamoja.
Check engine interface, wiring, inputs/outputs and the exact module revision before a replacement or retrofit.
Hakiki muunganisho wa injini, nyaya, ingizo/tokeo na toleo halisi la kidhibiti kabla ya kubadilisha au kuboresha mfumo.

intro: Configurable standby/prime controller with local monitoring and supported remote communication options.
Kidhibiti chenye mipangilio ya standby/prime, ufuatiliaji wa eneo na chaguo zinazoungwa mkono za mawasiliano ya mbali.
facts: Remote functions depend on the selected communication hardware, configuration, firmware and service plan.
Huduma za mbali hutegemea vifaa vya mawasiliano, mipangilio, firmware na mpango wa huduma uliochaguliwa.
A proposed retrofit is checked against the engine, sensors, panel wiring and required operating sequence.
Uboreshaji hupitiwa kulingana na injini, sensa, nyaya za paneli na mpangilio wa uendeshaji unaohitajika.

intro: A dedicated control reference for engineered multi-generator synchronising and load sharing.
Rejea ya kidhibiti maalumu cha kusawazisha jenereta kadhaa na kugawanya mzigo kwa usanifu unaofaa.
facts: Generator-to-generator load sharing is different from parallel operation with the utility. The full control and protection architecture must be reviewed.
Kugawanya mzigo kati ya jenereta ni tofauti na kuziendesha sambamba na umeme wa TANESCO. Mfumo mzima wa udhibiti na kinga unahitaji kupitiwa.
Governor/AVR interfaces, breakers, sensing, compatible controllers and commissioning are part of the assessment.
Miunganisho ya governor/AVR, breakers, vipimo, vidhibiti vinavyoendana na majaribio ya mwisho ni sehemu ya tathmini.

intro: A microgrid-control reference for a designed combination of generation, renewables and battery storage.
Rejea ya udhibiti wa mfumo unaochanganya jenereta, nishati jadidifu na hifadhi ya betri kwa usanifu maalumu.
facts: Device support, communication profiles and firmware must be checked for the particular inverter, battery and generator controls.
Uoanifu wa vifaa, mawasiliano na firmware uhakikiwe kwa inverter, betri na vidhibiti vya jenereta husika.
A hybrid system needs measured loads and a defined operating strategy; this controller is not a universal plug-and-play connection.
Mfumo mseto unahitaji vipimo vya mizigo na mpango wa uendeshaji; kidhibiti hiki hakiunganishi kila kifaa moja kwa moja bila usanifu.

title: Rental & temporary power
Ukodishaji na umeme wa muda
text: Cover a planned shutdown, a repair period or a temporary site. We define the duty, connection, access and operating arrangements before confirming availability.
Pata umeme wakati wa kazi zilizopangwa, matengenezo au shughuli za muda. Tunabainisha matumizi, muunganisho, ufikivu na uendeshaji kabla ya kuthibitisha upatikanaji.
details: Required running hours, loads and phase; delivery access, fuel responsibility, cabling and transfer arrangements. Capacity and dates confirmed per quotation.
Saa za matumizi, vifaa na awamu; ufikivu wa usafirishaji, wajibu wa mafuta, kebo na namna ya kubadili umeme. Uwezo na tarehe huthibitishwa kwenye nukuu.

title: Load-bank testing
Upimaji wa mzigo kwa load bank
text: Check generator performance under an agreed controlled load, with recorded readings and a clearly defined test report.
Pima utendaji wa jenereta kwa mzigo uliokubaliwa, pamoja na kumbukumbu za vipimo na ripoti yenye wigo wazi.
details: Agree resistive or resistive/reactive testing, ratings, duration, load steps, outage window and safe heat clearance. A no-load run is not the same test.
Kubalianeni upimaji wa resistive au resistive/reactive, uwezo, muda, hatua za mzigo, muda wa kusimamisha umeme na nafasi salama ya kutoa joto. Kuwasha bila mzigo si kipimo hiki.

title: Synchronisation & load sharing
Usawazishaji na mgawanyo wa mzigo
text: Coordinate multiple generator sets around the site's demand, controls and protection. Start with the existing system and the outcome required.
Panga jenereta kadhaa kulingana na mahitaji ya eneo, udhibiti na kinga. Anza na mfumo uliopo na matokeo unayohitaji.
details: Review set-to-set versus utility paralleling, governors/AVRs, breakers, controllers and protection. Applicable approvals and commissioning responsibilities are defined before work.
Pitia jenereta-kwa-jenereta dhidi ya kuendesha sambamba na utility, governor/AVR, breakers, vidhibiti na kinga. Idhini zinazohusika na majukumu ya majaribio hubainishwa kabla ya kazi.

title: Solar, generator & battery
Sola, jenereta na betri
text: Explore a coordinated hybrid around daytime use, night loads, generator runtime and critical circuits—not a promise that every device works with every other.
Tathmini mfumo mseto kwa matumizi ya mchana na usiku, saa za jenereta na saketi muhimu—si dhana kwamba kila kifaa kinaoana na kingine.
details: A measured load profile, inverter/BMS compatibility, generator start/stop interface, operating strategy and maintainable protection come before a final equipment proposal.
Vipimo vya matumizi, uoanifu wa inverter/BMS, muunganisho wa kuwasha/kuzima jenereta, mpango wa uendeshaji na kinga vinatangulia pendekezo la mwisho la vifaa.

q: What size generator does my building need?
Jengo langu linahitaji jenereta ya ukubwa gani?
a: Start with an equipment list, phase, normal demand, motor starting loads and what must run together. A bill or the sum of nameplates is not a complete sizing exercise. Duty rating, site conditions and future expansion also matter.

Anza na orodha ya vifaa, awamu, matumizi ya kawaida, mzigo wa kuanzisha mota na vifaa vinavyowashwa pamoja. Bili au kujumlisha nameplate si hesabu kamili. Aina ya matumizi, hali ya eneo na upanuzi wa baadaye pia huzingatiwa.

q: Will an ATS keep computers and medical equipment on without a break?
Je, ATS inazuia kabisa kompyuta na vifaa vya tiba kuzimika?
a: An ordinary generator/ATS sequence includes detection, starting and stabilisation time. Loads that cannot tolerate a break may need an appropriately designed UPS or other continuity system. Health-facility requirements must be defined with the responsible technical team.

Mpangilio wa kawaida wa jenereta/ATS una muda wa kutambua tatizo, kuwasha na kutuliza umeme. Vifaa visivyovumilia kukatika vinaweza kuhitaji UPS au mfumo mwingine uliosanifiwa. Mahitaji ya kituo cha afya yabainishwe na timu ya kiufundi inayohusika.

q: Can you repair or maintain an existing installation?
Mnaweza kutengeneza jenereta au mfumo uliopo?
a: Yes. Send the fault symptoms, make/model, serial number, controller type and service history. We assess the fault and agree repairs, parts and testing. Routine servicing follows the actual manufacturer's calendar/hour schedule; additional repairs are identified separately.

Ndiyo. Tuma dalili za hitilafu, chapa/modeli, namba ya utambulisho, aina ya kidhibiti na historia ya huduma. Tunatathmini na kukubaliana marekebisho, vipuri na vipimo. Huduma ya kawaida hufuata ratiba ya muda/saa ya mtengenezaji; marekebisho ya ziada hubainishwa tofauti.

q: Can I order a controller or parts without installation?
Naweza kuagiza kidhibiti au vipuri bila ufungaji?
a: Yes. Provide the exact part reference, model/serial details, photographs where helpful and quantity. We confirm compatibility, current price and availability before ordering. A similar-looking controller, filter or belt is not sufficient identification.

Ndiyo. Tuma namba ya kipuri, modeli/namba ya injini, picha inapohitajika na idadi. Tunathibitisha uoanifu, bei ya sasa na upatikanaji kabla ya kuagiza. Mwonekano unaofanana wa kidhibiti, kichujio au mkanda hautoshi.

q: Does remote monitoring work without internet?
Ufuatiliaji wa mbali unafanya kazi bila intaneti?
a: Local operation can be designed separately from cloud monitoring. Remote access needs compatible communication hardware, connectivity and an agreed platform/account. We define what is monitored, who receives alerts and what happens when communication is lost.

Uendeshaji wa eneo unaweza kupangwa tofauti na ufuatiliaji wa cloud. Huduma ya mbali inahitaji vifaa vya mawasiliano vinavyoendana, mtandao na akaunti/jukwaa lililokubaliwa. Tunabainisha vipimo, wapokeaji wa tahadhari na namna mfumo unavyofanya mawasiliano yanapokatika.

q: What is included in an installed quotation?
Nukuu ya ugavi na ufungaji inajumuisha nini?
a: The agreed scope should identify the set and duty rating, transfer/protection equipment, site works, cables, exhaust/ventilation, fuel arrangements, commissioning, handover and maintenance terms. Civil works, consumables and optional items should be clearly included or excluded.

Wigo ubainishe jenereta na duty rating, vifaa vya kubadili umeme/kinga, kazi za eneo, kebo, moshi/hewa, mpango wa mafuta, majaribio, makabidhiano na huduma. Kazi za ujenzi, vifaa vinavyotumika na chaguo za ziada zijulikane kama zimejumuishwa au la.
